label: Article 3 compliance
definition: Share of agglomerations of 2 000 p.e. and above that comply with Article 3 (collecting systems).

label: Article 3 compliance, 1 000 to 1 999 p.e.
definition: Estimated share of agglomerations of 1 000 to 1 999 p.e. that comply with Article 3.

label: Article 4 compliance
definition: Whether a system of authorisation and control of individual systems has been introduced in accordance with the Directive.

label: Article 5 management plans
definition: Number of agglomerations of 100 000 p.e. and above that already have an integrated urban wastewater management plan.

label: Article 6 compliance
definition: Share of agglomerations of 2 000 p.e. and above that comply with Article 6 (secondary treatment).

label: Article 6 compliance, 1 000 to 1 999 p.e.
definition: Estimated share of agglomerations of 1 000 to 1 999 p.e. that comply with Article 6.

label: Article 7 compliance
definition: Share of treatment plants of 150 000 p.e. and above that meet the Article 7 tertiary treatment requirements.

label: Article 8 compliance
definition: Share of treatment plants of 150 000 p.e. and above that meet the Article 8 quaternary treatment requirements.
